notes.title: Pushed Out Release Date
notes.notes:
Everyone,
I am truly sorry we did not make our estimated release date of 1 Aug. Upon review of what is still needing to be accomplished I have decided to push out the release date at least one month to make sure when the game is released it is a full game with little to no bugs. As customers you deserve the best even if it means waiting for it so I am going to ask everyone to wait just a little bit longer while I finish up.
Thank you everyone and stay tuned for the next patch updates!
